title: PCR Reaction for Experiments
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y52fy8e
materials: Spray entire work area with RNAway.
Allow reagents to thaw on ice
Vortex mix all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .
Hit PROCEED to select a reaction cycle.
Spin down all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .

steps.title: Prepare Work Area
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the work surface and equipment using 70% EtOH.

substeps.instruction: Spray the entire work area, including pipettes, tip holder for PCR tubes, and work surface with 70% EtOH.
Wipe the area with a paper towel.

steps.title: Prepare Ice Bath
steps.instruction: Set up a cooling station for reagents.

substeps.instruction: Fill a styrofoam container halfway with ice (located at Marley 527, across from Marley 509).
Place the PCR tube holder on the ice and allow it to cool for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Retrieve Reagents
steps.instruction: Move necessary materials from the freezer to the chilled tube holder.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Master Mix, primers, RNAse free water, and target tubes from the freezer to the PCR tube holder on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Vessels
steps.instruction: Label and handle PCR tubes while maintaining sterility.

substeps.instruction: Label one tube as 'NTC' and the other as 'TARG'.
Touch only the outside of the tubes and avoid touching the inside of the caps to prevent contamination.

steps.title: Assemble Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Add the required components to the NTC and TARG tubes.

steps.title: Homogenize and Concentrate Samples
steps.instruction: Mix and spin the reaction mixtures.

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Program
steps.instruction: Load samples into the thermocycler and initiate the EPCR program.

substeps.instruction: Place reaction vessels into the thermocycler.
Use the ' ' keys to navigate to the EPCR program.
Press PROCEED to begin the program.
